topics.title: Mental Musings and Mayhem
topics.summary: The program features a chaotic medley of songs centered around themes of mental instability and self-harm, including references to suicide, paranoia, and bizarre political aspirations. A mystery guest appears, attempting impressions and engaging in nonsensical conversations with the hosts before revealing himself as Rich Little.

topics.title: Impressions, Phone Calls & Carson
topics.summary: During a comedic segment, Rich Little recounts his struggles getting booked on Johnny Carson’s show due to past interactions with Joey Bishop. He shares impressions of George Washington and Abraham Lincoln via phone calls, including an awkward discussion about his wife's attractiveness and a splinter incident involving chewing gum.

topics.title: Stern and Kennison Argument
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, Howard Stern engaged in a heated argument with Sam Kennison over accusations of disrespect and unprofessional behavior. The discussion devolved into personal insults and criticisms, fueled by callers' outrage at the spectacle and highlighting tensions between the hosts.

topics.title: Radio Show Argument and Celebrity Interview
topics.summary: A radio show host engages in a heated argument with a former guest over perceived slights and career damage, escalating into inappropriate personal questions. Later, the program features an interview with Milton Berle who discusses his book, reminisces about past events at the Friars Club, and makes bizarre, unrelated comments including details of his sexual health and eating habits.

topics.title: California Club Membership Debate
topics.summary: A wealthy California club controversially admits a woman, sparking debate about membership rules and Howard Boyle discusses his son’s career as a glider pilot mechanic while expressing wistful thoughts about living with Uncle Milton. The conversation includes phone calls from the audience and an awkward discussion regarding personal finances.

topics.title: Boston Memories and Strange Calls
topics.summary: Howard recounts his impoverished upbringing in Boston with an allowance of $300, detailing awkward dates using cheap wine. He then discusses growing up in New York’s Roosevelt Long Island, sharing bizarre anecdotes about confusing street names on Oahu that he encountered while navigating.
